A semi-automated georeferencing software that followed the MaNIS georeferencing guidelines for point-radius and error estimations. Last active in 2006

Refers specifically to the MaNIS/HerpNet/ORNIS Georeferencing Guidelines which determines coordinates and uncertainty as an error estimate as interpreted from a textual description of a locality. (See also Wieczorek J, Hijmans R, Guo Q (2004) Point-radius method for georeferencing locality descriptions and calculating associated uncertainty. International Journal of Geographical Information Science 18(8):745-767.)
Mountain and Plains Spatio-Temporal Database-Informatics Initiative (MaPSTeaDI) georeferencing protocol.

An adaptation of Georeferencing for Dummies (Spencer et al 2008) and then later re-published as Wieczorek et al 2012 which provides examples of locality types and how to apply the point-radius method to georeferencing written localities. To reference earlier versions, please see MaNIS georeferencing guidelines.
An online updatable version of the Georeferencing Quick Reference Guide Version 2012-10-02 and its earlier precedents.
